text.hi: यह एक नाटक है: ग़रीब मोची देनू और उसकी पत्नी धनिया के पास आख़िरी चमड़ा बचा है। रात में परियाँ आकर उनके लिए जूते बना देती हैं!
text.hinglish: Yeh ek naatak hai: gareeb mochi Denu aur uski patni Dhania ke paas aakhiri chamda bacha hai. Raat mein pariyaan aakar unke liye joote bana deti hain!
text.en: This is a play: a poor cobbler, Denu, and his wife Dhania have their last piece of leather. At night, fairies come and make shoes for them!

steps.question: Who is a cobbler?
options: a person who makes and mends shoes
a person who makes gold ornaments
steps.answer: a person who makes and mends shoes
steps.modelAnswer: A cobbler is a person who makes and mends shoes.

modelMeaning.hi: मोची वह है जो जूते बनाता और ठीक करता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Mochi woh hai jo joote banaata aur theek karta hai.

steps.question: What is a fairy?
options: a tiny magical person in stories
steps.answer: a tiny magical person in stories
steps.modelAnswer: A fairy is a tiny magical person in stories, often with wings.

modelMeaning.hi: परी कहानियों में एक छोटी जादुई प्राणी होती है, अक्सर पंखों वाली।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Pari kahaaniyon mein ek chhoti jaadui praani hoti hai, aksar pankhon waali.

steps.meaning: the skin of animals used to make shoes and bags
steps.example: My father has a leather belt.

exampleMeaning.hi: पापा के पास चमड़े की बेल्ट है।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Papa ke paas chamde ki belt hai.

steps.meaning: a room where things are made or mended
steps.example: The carpenter works in his workshop.

exampleMeaning.hi: बढ़ई अपनी काम की जगह पर काम करता है।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Badhai apni kaam ki jagah par kaam karta hai.

exampleMeaning.hi: हमें ज़रूरतमंदों की मदद करनी चाहिए।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Humein zaroorat-mandon ki madad karni chahiye.

steps.example: The greedy dog lost its bone.

exampleMeaning.hi: लालची कुत्ते ने अपनी हड्डी खो दी।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Laalchi kutte ne apni haddi kho di.

steps.meaning: to join cloth or leather with a needle and thread (says ‘so’)

text.hi: किताब का नोट: sew को ‘सो’ बोलते हैं। तीन रूप: sew (सो), sewed (सोड), sewn (सोन)।
text.hinglish: Kitaab ka note: sew ko ‘so’ bolte hain. Teen roop: sew (so), sewed (sod), sewn (son).
text.en: A note from the book: ‘sew’ sounds like ‘so’. Its three forms: sew, sewed, sewn.
